answers_changed.input: When it comes to international trade, countries have always weighed economic efficiency against national security. After World War II, they pursued free international trade through low tariffs in the belief that it was both economically efficient and politically stabilizing. World trade tripled as a share of GDP between 1950 and its peak in 2008, with about half of this trade in intermediate goods, reflect- ing the importance of cross-border pro- duction relationships. Although conflict continued, there were no global-scale wars like those that characterized the first half of the 20th century. Globaliza- tion and stability had won out.
baseline: 在国际贸易方面，各国一直在经济效率与国家安全之间进行权衡。第二次世界大战后，他们通过低关税追求自由国际贸易，认为这既经济高效又有助于政治稳定。世界贸易占国内生产总值的比例从1950年到2008年达到顶峰时增长了三倍，其中约一半是中间产品贸易，反映了跨境生产关系的重要性。尽管冲突持续，但没有出现像20世纪上半叶那样的全球性战争。全球化和稳定性取得了胜利。

answers_changed.input: The world is now reevaluating the role of economic interconnectedness in global affairs, mindful that more inter- connection means more dependencies that adversarial nations can leverage to get their way in other areas of interna- tional relations. Resilient economies must be the response. A country must have access to the resources it needs to fight a protracted war. It must have a reliable supply of medicines, micro- chips, critical minerals, and other vital inputs, regardless of changing global alignment. And it must be able to rap- idly increase production in response to an emergency such as COVID-19.
baseline: 世界现在正在重新评估经济互联性在全球事务中的作用，意识到更多的互联意味着更多的依赖性，敌对国家可以利用这些依赖性在国际关系的其他领域达到他们的目的。应对之策是建设有韧性的经济体。一个国家必须能够获得打持久战所需的资源。无论全球格局如何变化，它都必须有可靠的药品、微芯片、关键矿物和其他重要投入品的供应。而且，它必须能够迅速增加生产，以应对COVID-19等紧急情况。
